correctness.rationale: Recomputed all three moments by expanding Cartesian coordinate differences and multiplying independent one-point mixed moments, without taking the source’s conditional distance powers as input. For powers (2m,2n,j), the one-point moment is R^(2m+2n)H^j times 3/(3+2m+2n+j) times (2m)!(2n)!/[4^(m+n)m!n!(m+n+1)!]; odd planar coordinate powers vanish. The exact expressions agree. The normalized fourth moment has derivative (32/63)(69r−236)/(r+8)^3; the interior minimum, excluded flat limit and excluded needle limit yield the specified preimage counts. In particular the first branch does not contribute at 113/63. At fixed M₁, r=1 and r=1730/227 give different cones with equal M₂. The independent rational substitution into the normalized sixth moment factors with the stated linear factor and positive quadratic, whose discriminant is −887538234128. Thus distinct candidates cannot also share M₃, and recovering R,H from r and M₁ gives global injectivity.
residual_risks: Only exact population moments for positive R,H with uniform volume sampling. No statistical stability or recovery among arbitrary convex bodies is shown.
